results.name: resourceGroup
results.reason: Learn selectorで2025-04-01が最新GAと確認し、固定REST resources.jsonのResourceGroup/TrackedResourceTags refsをSchemasで照合。name/location:string、tags additionalProperties:stringが一致し、location/name/tagsは全て指定。
results.migration: GA移行不要。現行2025-04-01が最新公開GAと一致。change logのTrackedResourceTags追加・ResourceGroupTags削除後もschemaはtags object<string>を維持し、systemDataは自動管理field。

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /name maps to ResourceGroup resource identity string. resourceGroupName is interpolated from abbreviations prefix, appName:string, and environment:string.

usage.label: location
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /location maps to REST ResourceGroup.location:string. Param location is string with default 'japaneast'.

usage.label: tags
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /tags maps to REST object additionalProperties:string. The sole azd-env-name value is environment:string.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$expression-line/0 is Bicep resource type/version header, not payload. Type/version is Microsoft.Resources/resourceGroups@2025-04-01.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/location/$expression-line/0 is location parameter annotation/declaration; string default japaneast supplies REST location:string.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/location/$expression-line/1 is location parameter annotation/declaration; string default japaneast supplies REST location:string.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/resourceGroupName/$expression-line/0 is resourceGroupName interpolation source using abbreviation prefix, appName:string and environment:string; output is resource name:string.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/abbrs/$expression-line/0 is abbreviations JSON loaded by loadJsonContent and supplies the resource-group name prefix; concatenated result is string.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/appName/$expression-line/0 is appName param string (default aks-chaos-lab) used in resourceGroupName interpolation.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/appName/$expression-line/1 is appName param string (default aks-chaos-lab) used in resourceGroupName interpolation.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/environment/$expression-line/0 is environment param string (default dev), used in name and tags map.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/environment/$expression-line/1 is environment param string (default dev), used in name and tags map.

usage.label: azd-env-name
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/tags/azd-env-name is source map value environment:string. JSON Pointer is in Bicep source, not a REST path; it maps to REST tags[azd-env-name]:string.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/tags/$expression-line/0 is tags map variable definition; its entries are strings and match REST additionalProperties:string.

current.analysis: Learn selector lists 2025-04-01 as Latest. Pinned resources README maps stable/2025-04-01/resources.json, where Schemas resolves ResourceGroup, TrackedResourceTags, location:string, and tags object<string>.

ga.analysis: Latest stable GA from Learn equals current. The exact candidate is the same pinned ResourceGroup schema.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log says 2025-04-01 adds TrackedResourceTags, removes ResourceGroupTags and adds systemData. Current schema continues tags as string-valued map; systemData is service-managed and not supplied.
